sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Quantitative measurement of cardiac troponin T or I (CPT code 84484) for the diagnosis of myocardial infarction (MI) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals presenting with any of the following: – Ischemic chest pain – Pain in the upper abdomen, shoulders, upper arms, forearms, wrists, fingers, neck and throat, lower jaw and teeth or back pain – Shortness of breath, belching, nausea, indigestion, vomiting, diaphoresis, dizziness, lightheadedness, clamminess or fatigue – Squeezing, tightness, pressure, constriction, crushing, strangling, burning, heartburn, fullness in the chest, band-like sensation, knot in the center of the chest, lump in throat, ache, heavy weight on chest or toothache when there is radiation to the lower jaw • A maximum of four serial quantitative troponin tests (CPT code 84484) IS REIMBURSABLE in the first three days after presentation. • Testing for natriuretic peptide, such as B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) or N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide (NT- proBNP) (CPT code 83880*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals presenting with dyspnea or shortness of breath. • Testing for BNP or NT-proBNP (CPT code 83880*) IS REIMBURSABLE every rolling 12 months for individuals presenting with any of the following: – Acute or chronic combined systolic and diastolic heart failure – Chronic heart failure: systolic, diastolic or combined systolic and diastolic – Chronic right heart failure • Measurement of the following cardiac biomarkers for the diagnosis or prognosis of MI IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in conjunction with the measurement of cardiac troponin T or I: Policy Number : LAB2023001 – Cardiac creatine kinase isoenzyme myocardial band (CK-MB) (CPT code 82553, CPT code 82554) – Copeptin (CPT code 84588) – C-reactive protein (CPT code 86140) – Creatine kinase (CK) (CPT code 82550) – CK isoenzymes (CPT code 82552) – Heart-type fatty acid binding protein (H-FABP) (CPT code 82725) – Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) (CPT code 83625) – Myoglobin (CPT code 83874) • For individuals with signs and symptoms of acute coronary syndrome, quantitative measurement of cardiac troponin T or I (CPT code 84484) by an independent laboratory IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • In the outpatient setting, qualitative measurement of cardiac troponin T or I (CPT code 84512) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • In the outpatient setting, testing of growth stimulation expressed gene 2 (ST2) or its isoforms (CPT code 83006) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
